## Linked course issue

Closes #<issue-number> (only if its Definition of Done is actually verified).

## Hypothesis and implementation

Describe methods, model/data revisions, token budget, and what changed.

## Verification

- [ ] Reproduction commands documented
- [ ] Tests passing / failures explained
- [ ] Frozen evaluation and per-item output preserved
- [ ] GPU/time/cost or explicit CPU-only limitations recorded
- [ ] No private data, credentials, or oversized weights committed

## Results and caveats

Include numerical results, unsuccessful variants, unexpected findings and next experiment.
